summary: Willamette NF lookout on Lamb Butte: firefinder 1930, cab built 1933, gone by 1959; sources disagree on design. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cab removed by 1959; no source describes what remains.

events.note: A firefinder was set up on the butte
L-6 cab (register, firelookout.com); L-5 ground house, 10x10 (history site)
Wind blew the shutters off the lookout house (Eugene Register-Guard item, quoted by the history site)
Gone by 1959 (register, firelookout.com); the history site says removed in the 1950s

evidence.quote: A firefinder was set up here in 1930.
This L-6 cab, built in 1933, was gone by 1959.
A firefinder was set up here in 1930.
This L-6 cab, built in 1933, was gone by 1959.
1933: A 10x10, L-5, lookout ground house constructed.

evidence.supports: wind blew shutters off the lookout house on top of the butte
evidence.quote: The wind was so strong that it blew the shutters off the lookout house on top of Lamb butte, southeast of McKenzie Bridge.

corrections.why: The register and firelookout.com both say L-6; the history site says L-5. Left for the editor to decide, not applied.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com say L-6 cab; the history site says L-5 ground house, 10x10. The story gives both and leads with the register's L-6.

notes_for_editor: Design disagrees: two sources say L-6 cab, the history site says L-5 ground house; the brief carried L-5. Correction proposed, not applied. AllTrails pages for the butte returned 403 and a search turned up no current-site description, so the story says nothing about what remains or access. No staffing or fire history appears in any of the three sources.
